system.description: Spend two Blood Traits (three if you have been incapacitated by a stake through the heart) to violently expel all foreign objects from your body at once, including bullets, splinters, and stakes. Anyone in the path of an ejected object must win a Physical Challenge against a number of Traits equal to your Protean rating or take one bashing health level per object that hits them. Spending a Willpower Trait lets you leave some objects in place, whether fully or partially embedded, and this power functions even while staked.
